gear: Standard alpine trad rack (cams and nuts)
Approach shoes or light boots for the glacier/4th-class sections

itinerary.cal: Northern Pickets approaches are typically not in good condition until mid-July, once Wiley Ridge brush eases and Big Beaver Creek fords back off; a North Cascades NPS backcountry permit is required for all camps.

days.note: Water-taxi across Ross Lake to the Big Beaver trailhead, then an easy but long trail day up Big Beaver Creek to Luna Camp, carrying 5-6 days of food.
days.title: Ross Lake to Luna Camp
days.objective: Reach Luna Camp on the Big Beaver Trail

days.note: Leave the trail and climb steep timber and brush onto Wiley Ridge, then traverse cross-country into Luna Basin below the Luna Glacier. Slow, route-finding-heavy travel through slide alder and boulder fields.
days.title: Wiley Ridge to Luna Basin high camp
days.objective: Establish high camp near the Luna Glacier

days.note: A short technical day gaining the moraine and glacier margin, roping up for crevassed terrain to place an advance camp within striking distance of the route.
days.title: Move to advanced glacier camp
days.objective: Position below the Luna Glacier icefall

days.note: Alpine start onto the glacier, crossing crevasses and a bergschrund to the base of the route, then four pitches of moderate alpine rock/ice to the summit ridge before reversing the entire route back to advance camp.
days.title: Summit via the Luna Glacier

schedule.label: Leave advance camp
schedule.detail: Rope up immediately for crevassed glacier travel.

schedule.label: Climb the 4 pitches
schedule.detail: Moderate alpine rock/ice to the summit ridge.

schedule.label: Begin descent
schedule.detail: Reverse pitches and re-cross the glacier.

days.objective: Climb Phantom Peak's Luna Glacier route (4 pitches)

days.note: Break camp and reverse the Wiley Ridge / Luna Basin cross-country descent back to the Big Beaver Trail at Luna Camp.
days.title: Descend to Luna Camp

days.note: Easy trail miles back down Big Beaver Creek to Ross Lake and the water taxi/trailhead.
days.title: Hike out to trailhead

itinerary.totalNote: A remote 6-day expedition, roughly 38-40 miles round trip with one 4-pitch technical summit day via the Luna Glacier; most parties spend two nights in Luna Basin plus a lighter advance camp for the push.
